q: Conversion of light energy into ______ is based on a phenomenon called photovoltaic effect. 2025
e: The photovoltaic effect directly converts light energy into electrical energy.

q: Which of the following energy sources is considered a renewable energy source? 2024
e: Wind energy is naturally replenished on a human timescale, making it renewable.

q: Biomass is renewable ______ material that comes from plants and animals. 2024
e: Biomass consists of organic material derived from living organisms.

q: Non-renewable energy resources include ______. 2024
e: Coal is a fossil fuel available in finite amounts.

q: What type of energy is stored in the fossil fuels? 2025
e: Fossil fuels store chemical energy within their molecular bonds.

q: There are ______ types of concentrated solar power (CSP) technologies. 2025
e: There are four primary CSP technologies: parabolic trough, solar power tower, linear Fresnel reflector, and dish/engine.

q: A large amount of ______ energy is stored on the fossil fuels. 2025
e: Fossil fuels contain large quantities of stored chemical energy.

q: Today's world consumption of energy is of the order of ______ Btu/year. 2025
e: Global energy consumption is approximately 10^17 Btu per year.

q: What principle pulls water into the penstock? 2021
a: Force of the volume of water
e: Gravity draws water downward through the penstock.

q: Which statement is true? 2025
a: Modern turbines reduce noise and flicker
e: Advancements in turbine design have reduced mechanical noise and shadow flicker.

q: Which of the following energy sources is classified as renewable? 2025
e: Solar energy is continuously replenished by the sun.

q: Non-renewable energy sources are finite and cannot be easily replenished within a short timeframe. Examples include: 2025
e: Coal formation takes millions of years, making it finite and non-renewable.

q: Which of the following is a non-renewable source of energy? 2025
e: Fossil fuels are exhaustible energy sources.

q: What is the main constituent of fossil fuels? 2025
e: Fossil fuels are hydrocarbon compounds consisting mainly of carbon.

q: What type of energy is stored in the fossil fuels? 2025
e: Fossil fuels store energy in chemical bonds.

q: A large amount of ______ is stored in the fossil fuels. 2025
e: Chemical energy is stored in large amounts in fossil fuels.

q: Which of the following is a non-renewable source of energy? 2025
e: Fossil fuels cannot be replenished quickly and are non-renewable.

q: Windmills convert wind energy directly into ______. 2025
e: Windmills directly harness wind power to produce mechanical energy.

q: Solar energy is the radiant light and heat from the ______. 2025
e: Solar energy is energy harnessed from the sun's radiation.

q: Non-renewable energy sources are available only in ______ supply. 2026
e: Non-renewable energy resources exist in finite, limited quantities.

q: What is the main source of geothermal energy? 2026
e: Geothermal energy originates from heat generated within the interior of the Earth.

q: Which is NOT a socioeconomic factor that contributes to the energy crisis? 2026
e: The temperature of the Sun is a natural astronomical factor, not a socioeconomic one.
